title: Filipino-Style Fish Adobo Jjigae
description: A fusion dish that combines the flavors of Filipino adobo with the spicy kick of Korean jjigae, featuring kissed fish in a savory sauce.
instructions: Season the fish with Monsoon Sea Salt and Black Pepper.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the Filipino Adobo Sauce and Gochujang, stir to combine.
Add the fish to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the fish to a plate and set aside.
Add the Rice Vinegar to the skillet and stir to deglaze.
Return the fish to the skillet and simmer for 2 minutes.
Garnish with Green Onions and serve immediately.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles.
